hazards.title: Rotor imbalance or loosened rotating mass
hazards.likelihood_basis: Credible during commissioning and after wear; apparatus-specific occurrence data do not yet exist.

controls.description: Bound admitted load and imbalance; contain the maximum credible fragment and feedstock projectile.
controls.verification: Calculation and witnessed containment test for the defined envelope.

response: latch fault and require rotor inspection
hazards.residual_risk: Unbounded until rotor, enclosure, mounting, sensors, and stop behavior are specified.
open_questions: What imbalance metric and persistence limit protect the selected rotor and enclosure?

hazards.title: Overspeed or speed-sensor disagreement
hazards.likelihood_basis: A credible single-control or sensing fault; no validated drive architecture exists.

controls.description: Use an independent speed-limiting path and configuration-bound maximum.
controls.verification: Inject primary-control and sensor faults without exceeding the verified limit.

hazards.residual_risk: Independent limit, response time, and braking consequence remain apparatus-specific.
open_questions: What maximum credible speed remains after every single drive and control fault?

hazards.title: Rotor, shaft, bearing, fastener, or chamber failure
hazards.likelihood_basis: Credible over service life; materials, loads, duty cycle, and retirement limits are unresolved.

controls.description: Configuration-control critical parts and retire them by verified life or condition limit.
controls.verification: Design analysis, inspection validation, and retirement-record audit.

response: replace or inspect affected protected modules

verification.reference: Structural, fatigue, retention, and credible-fragment analysis

hazards.residual_risk: Cannot be ranked until configuration, credible failure energy, and service life are defined.
open_questions: Which parts are life-limited and what evidence sets each retirement point?

hazards.title: Jam, bridging, blocked outlet, or feed surge
hazards.likelihood_basis: Expected misuse and process upset for heterogeneous material streams.

controls.description: Isolate the feed and provide a no-reach clearing method with residual-energy verification.
controls.verification: Jam tests covering the admitted size, shape, moisture, and feed-rate envelope.

response: stop feed before opening any path

verification.reference: Bounded jam and blockage recovery test matrix

hazards.residual_risk: Detection thresholds and the clearing mechanism are not yet selected.
open_questions: Can every credible jam be cleared without entering a hazardous zone?

hazards.title: Dust, fines, aerosols, or electrostatic charging
hazards.likelihood_basis: Fine solids are a foreseeable product of sorting and wear; combustibility is material-specific.

controls.description: Admit dust-forming material only under a documented dust, ignition, grounding, capture, and housekeeping envelope.
controls.verification: Material review and controlled capture tests; specialist review where combustible dust is credible.

hazards.residual_risk: No material may inherit a generic noncombustible or nonhazardous classification.
open_questions: Which candidate materials and wear products require specialist dust testing?

hazards.title: Fire, smoke, abnormal heat, or hot accessible surface
hazards.likelihood_basis: Credible electrical, mechanical, and material ignition sources exist in the concept.
detection: smoke or fire detection where justified

controls.description: Separate ignition sources from admitted material hazards and define compatible detection, isolation, ventilation, and suppression.
controls.verification: Thermal analysis and independently reviewed fire-response tests appropriate to the apparatus.

response: isolate energy as the event permits
continue or isolate ventilation according to tested fire scenario

verification.reference: Select jurisdiction, fire scenarios, detection, and compatible suppression before fire testing

hazards.residual_risk: Ventilation and suppression choices may worsen some events and require scenario-specific evidence.
open_questions: Which fire classes can occur in each isolated subsystem?

hazards.title: Leak, failed seal, detached collector, or ruptured duct
hazards.likelihood_basis: Repeatedly opened bins, filters, and service closures make seal and seating faults foreseeable.

controls.description: Key and monitor safety-critical closures and provide secondary containment where a single leak is consequential.
controls.verification: Deliberate incomplete-seating, seal-fault, and collector-removal tests.

response: control extraction according to release type
hazards.residual_risk: Detection coverage depends on the final opening and duct inventory.
open_questions: Which boundaries require active leak detection versus inspected passive containment?

hazards.title: Unexpected pressure or vacuum
hazards.likelihood_basis: Credible in a closed or partially closed forced-air system.

controls.description: Define structural pressure limits, operating trips, and a safely directed relief path.
controls.verification: Pressure analysis and bounded proof test before material operation.

response: move gates only under verified safe sequencing
retain locks until pressure is verified safe
hazards.residual_risk: No pressure rating or relief architecture is currently defined.
open_questions: What maximum credible pressure and vacuum follow from each fan, blockage, and material scenario?

hazards.title: Harmful noise or vibration exposure
hazards.likelihood_basis: Continuous rotation, impacts, and airflow produce foreseeable domestic noise and vibration.
detection: vibration at machine and building interfaces

controls.description: Bound operating exposure and prevent mounting or enclosure resonance across the admitted speed range.
controls.verification: Measured acoustic and vibration survey in the specified installation.

response: reduce or stop operation outside the commissioned envelope
hazards.residual_risk: Limits depend on jurisdiction, room, mounting, duration, and occupant exposure.
open_questions: What installation and occupancy assumptions define acceptable exposure?

hazards.title: Electrical shock, short circuit, or moisture ingress
hazards.likelihood_basis: Domestic use, cleaning, motors, sensors, and conductive material create credible exposure.

controls.description: Provide jurisdiction-appropriate electrical protection, isolation, grounding, ingress control, and post-service verification.
controls.verification: Inspection and electrical safety tests mapped to the final product category and jurisdiction.

response: remove hazardous electrical energy through protective devices
require trained inspection after ingress or protection trip

verification.reference: Identify product category, supply, installation class, and applicable electrical standards

hazards.residual_risk: Cannot be qualified without an electrical architecture and jurisdiction.
open_questions: Will wet cleaning be admitted anywhere adjacent to energized equipment?

hazards.title: Loss, staleness, or corruption of safety instrumentation
hazards.likelihood_basis: All proposed protective functions depend on measurements not yet architected.
detection: redundant or diverse observation where consequence requires it

controls.description: Treat unavailable, stale, implausible, or uncalibrated required evidence as refusal rather than a default value.
controls.verification: Fault injection for missing, frozen, delayed, biased, and contradictory sensor data.

response: block READY or enter controlled refusal
retain access lock when safety cannot be demonstrated
hazards.residual_risk: Independent evidence requirements depend on the consequence of each missed observation.
open_questions: Which variables require diverse rather than merely duplicated sensing?

hazards.title: Software, actuator, watchdog, or communications fault
hazards.likelihood_basis: A networked multi-subsystem controller necessarily presents command and sequencing faults.

controls.description: Keep protective behavior local, reject invalid sequences, and provide an independent physical fallback for high-consequence control failures.
controls.verification: Controller restart, timeout, invalid-command, stuck-actuator, and lost-network tests.

response: enter the locally defined safe response
record commanded and observed states separately
hazards.residual_risk: Final allocation between mechanical, safety-control, and process-control layers is unresolved.
open_questions: Which actuators require position proof or an independently safe de-energized state?

hazards.title: Wrong, mixed, wet, reactive, biological, sharp, fragile, or unknown input
hazards.likelihood_basis: Heterogeneous household inputs make ambiguity and concealed hazards normal rather than exceptional.

controls.description: Quarantine before destructive action and refuse when credible uncertainty includes a hard-refusal class.
controls.verification: Adversarial admission tests using mislabeled, concealed, mixed, wet, and unknown specimens without destructive processing.

response: prevent laundering unknown status into an output class
hazards.residual_risk: No characterization system can prove absence of every hidden hazard.
open_questions: What minimum observations are required for each named process?

hazards.title: Cross-contamination among recovery, food, clothing, and fabrication paths
hazards.likelihood_basis: The complete vision combines domains that cannot safely share an unqualified material path.

controls.description: Physically isolate the food domain and require downstream material contracts for every other transition.
controls.verification: Route single-fault analysis, tracer tests, and process-specific cleaning validation.

response: clean and revalidate the affected boundary
hazards.residual_risk: Food-contact suitability remains process-specific and cannot be inferred from sorting or washing.
open_questions: Can the final architecture demonstrate no single-fault connection to the food domain?

hazards.title: Maintenance error or incomplete reassembly
hazards.likelihood_basis: Repeated cleaning and consumable replacement make assembly errors foreseeable.

controls.description: Classify service authority and make safety-critical omission, reversal, substitution, and bypass detectable before READY.
controls.verification: Deliberate misassembly and omitted-step tests followed by return-to-service validation.

response: identify the incomplete or incompatible configuration
require the specified authority and test
hazards.residual_risk: Service classification and replace-only module boundaries remain to be allocated.
open_questions: Which components can safely remain user-serviceable?

hazards.title: Child, pet, bystander, or accessibility-related misuse
hazards.likelihood_basis: Foreseeable in a domestic environment and not adequately controlled by instructions alone.
detection: closure and presence state where justified

controls.description: Prevent hazardous reach, unintended start, entrapment, and instability through geometry, guards, interlocks, and installation.
controls.verification: Accessibility, reach, force, stability, entrapment, and status-comprehension evaluation.

response: retain or release locks according to the lower-risk state
provide direct local alarm and recovery guidance

verification.reference: Select applicable domestic product and accessibility standards for target jurisdiction

hazards.residual_risk: User populations, installation, controls, and openings are not yet dimensioned.
open_questions: What users and environments define foreseeable access and misuse?

hazards.title: Flood, tip-over, external fire, or building-power disturbance
hazards.likelihood_basis: External domestic disturbances are credible over product life and can coincide with stored energy.
detection: tilt or mounting inspection where justified
moisture or fire indication where applicable

controls.description: Specify anchoring, clearances, drainage, environmental limits, energy isolation, and post-event inspection.
controls.verification: Installation review and bounded disturbance tests mapped to the final jurisdiction and apparatus.

response: move to the safest locally reachable state

verification.reference: Define installation classes and external-event design basis

hazards.residual_risk: Building interface and installation environment are not yet specified.
open_questions: Which external events must the installed apparatus withstand versus detect and refuse after?
